policy.authority: One native scene capture, updater and planner; executors consume resolved values.
policy.readiness: Candidates are implemented/tested in the local integration, not validated as upstream-ready patches.
policy.export: Review semantic hunks against the pinned fork; never replace complete mixed files.
policy.native_boundary: Candidate source must not depend on CoinRender targets, FramePlan transport, bgfx or wgpu.
policy.compatibility: Imported baseline and older-Coin compatibility are separate from upstream contributions.

features.title: Preserve logical scene state
features.scope: Native fog, world clipping planes, texture transform, logical Environment/Complexity/DepthBuffer state; preserve existing fork material contracts.

features.title: Conservative state dependencies and projection updates
features.scope: Track camera/positional-light/clip dependencies; qualify single-camera in-scene projection updates; conservative replay and state-leaking Switch handling.

features.title: Capture attenuation at each light occurrence
features.scope: Store attenuation beside the light matrix instead of reading a later environment at shape capture.

features.title: Geometry and object-order semantics
features.scope: Shared cube geometry matching generated corners/normals/UVs; whole-object center across material batches; native captured/opaque-first/back-to-front order policies.

features.title: Compact native command and path storage
features.scope: Opt-in interned commands, exact model reconstruction, flat ownership and compact paths. Original fork consumers use reference/array access and may expand storage; adapt manager/GL executor and measure there before export.

features.title: Authored depth provenance
features.scope: Generic depth mask is implemented locally but primarily serves CoinRender delayed-state/instancing admission. Require a native fork consumer or correctness case before expanding its IR/API.

features.title: Retained image upload-quality semantics
features.scope: Preserve retained quality and quality-zero disable. Review the current getGLImageUploadHints dependency; a logical capture must not require an executor or GL context to run first.

features.title: Deterministic render parameter defaults
features.scope: Explicit identity matrices and transparent-black clear RGBA defaults; native Coin-only default-parameter regression. No renderer dependency.

features.title: CoinRender retained facade and admission
features.scope: CoinRenderRetainedRenderer, bounded capture profile and caller-driven notification collector; do not transplant its allowlist into the general fork capture.

features.title: Native IR to CoinRender transport
features.scope: Translate into FramePlan snapshots, material slots, image/sampler data, stroke lowering, geometry span patches and target rebinding. No scene traversal or planning.

features.title: Resolved order receipt and publication ownership
features.scope: Consume native order without another classifier; compact composition views, lexical borrow authority, revision checks and target publication remain CoinRender contracts.

features.title: BGFX execution and instancing
features.scope: BGFX lowering, uploads, shaders/depth admission and executor-specific regression controls.

features.title: wgpu execution and FFI
features.scope: wgpu/Rust envelope and lowering of CoinRender-owned snapshots.

features.title: Cross-backend and Android qualification
features.scope: Current tests link CoinRender targets. Portable scenarios can be re-expressed in fork tests, but these test binaries are not native upstream tests.

features.title: Older Coin compatibility and imported baseline
features.scope: Imported dispatch/elements/helpers, lazy snapshot shim, private accessor compatibility and DLL exports. Existing upstream features are not new contributions.

features.title: Build, initialization and provenance
features.scope: Separate registrations for genuinely new native features from local import, CoinRender target and packaging changes.

features.title: Native retained PBR material capture
features.scope: Backend-neutral immutable authored PBR descriptors, native node/element state, compact keys and planner comparisons. Native API/resource design requires fork review; shader/IBL/exposure execution stays in CoinRender.

features.title: PBR transport and BGFX HDR execution
features.scope: PBR branch DTO and shader dependency slice, mechanical native descriptor conversion, BGFX Vulkan offscreen RGBA16F and Neutral/sRGB output, current-capture control and exact three-path comparisons. No native traversal/planner or GPU code exported to the fork. Output exposure changes preserve capture, plan, transport and depth; 3D gallery examples compare against both current capture and the pinned PBR branch.

features.title: Optional CPU HDR environment payload and preparation
features.scope: CoinEnvironment package validation/baking and math imported unchanged from codex/pbr-clean; links Coin only. Candidate reusable CPU resource module, not a native scene action or automatic fork export. Local build/install registration must be split.

features.title: Global isotropic IBL in retained BGFX PBR
features.scope: Target-owned immutable .cibl CPU snapshot, GGX cube/LUT/average uploads, SH9 and view-to-world uniforms, rotation/intensity without capture/plan/reupload, and exact current/retained/pinned-source controls. No IBL state added to scene capture/planning.

features.title: FreeCAD Assembly retained PBR viewport connector
features.scope: Isolated Coin ABI, one retained scene/action/planner, Qt readback presentation with legacy rendering disabled, FreeCAD picking, object highlighting and rigid link placement/visibility/camera updates. Not a native BGFX swapchain or general FreeCAD custom-node capture.

features.title: Native BGFX FreeCAD viewport presentation
features.scope: Native Vulkan output to host Xlib child surface, zero pixel transport to Qt, fenced target/window lifetime, source pick viewport metadata and independent presented-image controls; no native capture/planner changes.

features.title: Assembly appearance presets and controlled native previews
features.scope: Optional validated per-link PBR factors, proposed AssemblyExample materials, geometry-only framing and native surface look-development captures; no shader, IR, planner or document material mutation.

features.title: Native PBR directional shadows, SSAO and background
features.scope: Executor-only directional PCF and screen-space AO depth passes reuse supplied retained geometry/plan; cached immutable-borrow identity, budgeted resources and application studio authoring. No additional graph action or native semantic planning.

features.title: PBR static radiance reuse and depth-only effect attachments
features.scope: Reuse completed immutable native PBR HDR radiance for forced static repaints; preserve normal fences for changed scenes and drain queued static presentation before XID retirement. Depth-only D24S8 effect FBOs remove dummy color attachments. Fresh-process FreeCAD PSS/RSS, timing and GPU profiling controls; no native capture/planner changes.

features.title: Retained PBR image roles, coordinate sets and scalar updates
features.scope: Logical stored images/normal sources and per-unit coordinates captured once; state-path PBR scalar replay updates immutable descriptors without recapture or planning. No executor types or tangent generation in native IR.

features.title: PBR surface preparation and native viewport maps
features.scope: Adapt pinned PBR image-role conversion, mip generation, height normals and MikkTSpace after authoritative capture; optional sparse tangents, BGFX bindings and incremental factors. Optional FreeCAD per-link maps and scalar protocol; callback and pinned SDK image controls.

features.title: PBR tangent coordinate demand and retained direction provenance
features.scope: Generate UV indices independently of images for native/callback PBR, preserve the independent direction matrix and retain coordinate provenance across lobe disable/enable. Scalar strength/rotation replay remains native; no tangent generation or GPU handles.

features.title: Renderer-independent anisotropic directional albedo product
features.scope: Optional CoinEnvironment CPU preparation/read/write/evaluation of versioned anisotropic albedo tables imported from pinned pbr-clean; independent numerical tests, budgets and rollback. Qualify a fork consumer before proposing optional SDK expansion.

features.title: Retained BGFX anisotropy and VNDF global IBL
features.scope: Consume native direction/UV state with shared MikkTSpace, bind authored strength/rotation, source/prefiltered cube arrays and prepared albedo tables. Bounded 0–128 source samples (default 16), explicit CPU/GPU budgets, native FreeCAD scalar packets and same-camera reference controls. No local probes, refinement or second capture/planner.

features.title: Validate closed CAD meshes before retained viewport import
features.scope: Reject incomplete or misoriented triangle meshes of closed CAD solids; retry invalid ingress tessellation through MeshPart with explicit angular bounds before the single Coin capture/planner. Record mesh attempts/provenance and independently test solid topology/volume. No backend or native fork changes.

features.title: GPU-only smooth planar PBR reflection from retained draws
features.scope: Adapt pinned PBR camera reflection/far-plane formulas; encode one auxiliary HDR/depth view over the same VBO/IBO and supplied draw order, world clipping, reflected light/tangent frames and shared world shadows/IBL. Explicit smooth coplanar receivers, budgets, 1/2/4 resolution and failure/retry; native static reuse and independent geometric oracle. No scene recapture, second planner, child transport or local-probe/rough-reflection claim.

features.title: Rough planar GGX reflection over retained HDR
features.scope: Adapt pinned finite canonical proxy mapping and connect the identical 128-tap premultiplied GGX filter to retained BGFX reflection. Same capture, plan, buffers and mirrored GPU pass; explicit rough selector, budgets, linear sampling, smooth reset, native reuse and source mapping controls. No native fork semantics or local probes.
